\emph{Phase transition between 384 and 512 tokens}: the tail-384 column reveals that the transition is not instantaneous at 256$\to$512 but localized between 384 and 512 tokens.

\emph{Convergence at tail-512+}: once the phase transition is crossed, accuracy converges across all models into a 93.6--97.5\% band at tail-512 (seed 42).
Multi-seed validation confirms robustness: across verified model$\times$seed combinations at tail-512, all accuracies fall within [93.61\%, 98.24\%], a 4.63pp band that compresses the signal-poor tail-256 spread (6.3pp) by 27\%.
At tail-1024, four models reach 96.5--98.2\% (CodeLlama 98.2\% under label-only loss, three others 96.5--96.6\%).
Scale and architecture differences that dominate the signal-poor regime (tail-256 range: 72.6--78.9\%, 6.3pp) compress dramatically in the signal-rich regime.

%% ============================================================
\section{Calibration Analysis}
\label{sec:calibration_full}

Beyond accuracy, we evaluate whether trace conditions affect prediction calibration, motivated by recent findings that code LLM confidence is often poorly calibrated \citep{spiess2025calibration}.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\caption{Calibration metrics on Qwen-2.5-7B ($N{=}1{,}190$, seed=42). ECE = expected calibration error; Brier = Brier score. Lower is better for both.}
\label{tab:calibration}
\small
\begin{tabular}{lcc}
\toprule
\textbf{Condition} & \textbf{ECE $\downarrow$} & \textbf{Brier $\downarrow$} \\
\midrule
ae\_only & \textbf{0.0004} & \textbf{0.0008} \\
exception\_only & 0.0027 & 0.0013 \\
VOTA & 0.0054 & 0.005 \\
full\_trace & 0.096 & 0.144 \\
no\_trace & 0.171 & 0.197 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

Table~\ref{tab:calibration} shows that calibration quality mirrors the Tier~1/2 hierarchy.
Tier~1 conditions (\texttt{ae\_only}: ECE=0.0004; \texttt{exception\_only}: ECE=0.0027) produce near-perfectly calibrated predictions, while \texttt{full\_trace} (ECE=0.096) and \texttt{no\_trace} (ECE=0.171) exhibit substantial miscalibration.
VOTA (ECE=0.0054) is well-calibrated but slightly worse than either Tier~1 component alone, reinforcing the pattern that combining trace signals dilutes rather than improves the prediction signal.

The Brier scores tell a consistent story: \texttt{ae\_only} (0.0008) and \texttt{exception\_only} (0.0013) achieve near-zero scores, while \texttt{no\_trace} (0.197) indicates substantial miscalibration.

"""Generate cross-model tail-truncation budget curve figure."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 7.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.03,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'text.usetex': False,
})

budgets = [256, 384, 512, 1024]
budget_labels = ['256', '384', '512', '1024']

models = {
    'Qwen-7B': {
        'tail': [78.82, 79.92, 93.61, 96.47],
        'exc_only': 99.83,
        'no_trace': 75.13,
        'color': '#2171B5',
        'marker': 'o',
    },
    'DeepSeek-6.7B': {
        'tail': [74.37, 82.86, 93.95, 95.04],
        'exc_only': 99.33,
        'no_trace': 73.36,
        'color': '#E6550D',
        'marker': 's',
    },
    'CodeLlama-13B': {
        'tail': [77.73, 80.59, 96.47, 98.24],
        'exc_only': 99.89,
        'no_trace': 76.47,
        'color': '#31A354',
        'marker': '^',
    },
    'Qwen-1.5B': {
        'tail': [72.61, 73.61, 95.63, 97.56],
        'exc_only': 99.83,
        'no_trace': 67.31,
        'color': '#756BB1',
        'marker': 'D',
    },
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.5))

x = np.arange(len(budgets))

for name, m in models.items():
    ax.plot(x, m['tail'], marker=m['marker'], color=m['color'],
            linewidth=1.4, markersize=4.5, label=name, zorder=3)

exc_min = min(m['exc_only'] for m in models.values())
exc_max = max(m['exc_only'] for m in models.values())
ax.axhspan(exc_min, exc_max, alpha=0.08, color='#2CA02C', zorder=1)
ax.axhline(y=exc_min, color='#2CA02C', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax.text(-0.15, exc_max + 0.3, 'exception_only',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#2CA02C', ha='left', va='bottom')

nt_min = min(m['no_trace'] for m in models.values())
nt_max = max(m['no_trace'] for m in models.values())
ax.axhspan(nt_min, nt_max, alpha=0.06, color='#999999', zorder=1)
ax.axhline(y=nt_max, color='#999999', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax.text(-0.15, nt_min - 0.5, 'no_trace',
        fontsize=6.5, color='#777777', ha='left', va='top')

ax.axvspan(1, 2, alpha=0.05, color='#FF7F0E', zorder=0)
ax.annotate('transition\nzone', xy=(1.5, 87), fontsize=6.5, color='#CC6600',
            ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(budget_labels)
ax.set_xlabel('Tail token budget')
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_ylim(63, 102)
ax.set_xlim(-0.25, len(budgets) - 0.75)

ax.legend(loc='center left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 0.38),
          framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
          borderpad=0.3, handlelength=1.3, handletextpad=0.3)

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.5)

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_4/projects/trace-verdict-study/figures/paper/budget_curve.pdf'
fig.savefig(out)
out_png = out.replace('.pdf', '.png')
fig.savefig(out_png)
print(f'Saved: {out}')
print(f'Saved: {out_png}')
plt.close()
